notes.title: Leaving Early Acces
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After four years of development, we are proud (yes, proud is the right word) to announce that the final version of IMPAVIDVM will be available to everyone from May 9, 2023.

We apologize for taking so long, but we are a small team of two people who have tried to make the game to the best of our abilities.

The final version includes 11 playable levels (plus one), 4 cutscenes, and two endings. The levels were supposed to be 14, but we decided to reduce them to 12 because, as we are, making two extra levels would have required at least another year!

IMPAVIDVM is an old-style platform game inspired by great classics of the past, such as the famous Prince of Persia. We have spent an incredible amount of time getting the gameplay we set out to achieve, and we believe we have succeeded.

The idea is to offer you an old-style platform game but with modern elements. Therefore:

- IMPVIDVUM has a complete and engaging storyline that you will discover gradually and will be fully revealed only at the end!

- A dedicated game mode will help speedrunners who decide to destroy the game and shatter all records.

- The movements of the characters try to respect the canons of a real person. If you press the jump button and find yourself falling into a chasm, pay attention to how the character's feet were positioned when you pressed the button (if you were running in real life and suddenly asked to jump, you could do it right away or you might need a foothold to give you momentum?)

- The numerous checkpoints will prevent you from having to repeat the most difficult parts over and over again!

That being said, do not expect any kind of help. 
You will not receive any pop-ups telling you which button to press and when. 
There will be no quick time events. 
No off-screen voice will tell you how to solve a puzzle after the third attempt. 
The game interface is not minimalist. There is no interface! 
IMPAVIDVM respects your intelligence too much to help you.

All we want is for you to have fun. 
If you feel that pleasant thrill of satisfaction every time you overcome a difficult part or solve a puzzle; if you find yourself wondering who has imprisoned you in this fortress and why, then we will know that our work has served its purpose, which has always been to entertain you and make you have fun. 
Have fun! 
This is the only thing we ask in exchange for our work.

Per ardua ad astra

notes.title: SMALL UPDATE (CONTROLLER IMPROVEMENT)
notes.content:
1) STEAM CONTROLLER SUPPORT
We now use the steam API to manage controllers. It is much easier and avoids a lot of headache. Thanks Valve!

2) CHANGED CONTROL SCHEME
We revisited all controls in the game to make them feel more "natural", both on keyboard and contoller. We introduced the "jump" action that is no longer the same as "Up" and we separated the actions "Grab" and "Interact". Any continuous action that must be performed with hands is now a grab action even if does not require to keep the button down (i.e. grabbing rope, monkey walk, poles and so on). Any interactions with other objects in world (levers, wheels, teleports and such) is now an interact button

3) ADDED A TIMER FOR HOLDING THE GRAB BUTTON
It was possible before to just keep the grab button down for the entire play session and not be worried about grabbing an object at the right time. We added a timer so, if the button is pressed for too long, it will be ignored. This forces the player to use the button when they really want to grab something and pay more attention to the environment. The timer is generous so it does not make the grab action too hard.

4) IMPROVED DEFAULT CONTROLLER CONFIGURATION ON STEAM
We added separated actions to navigate the menus. This makes the controller feel more natural.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE FOR IMPAVIDVM
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
As already anticipated, we are releasing a new major update for IMPAVIDVM with a lot of new stuff.
Enjoy!

1) NEW LEVEL 'FORTITVDO'
A brand new level has been added.

2) SECOND CUTSCENE
We keep developing the plot and the second cutscene has been added to the game.

3) ADDED CONTROLLER SUPPORT.
It is now possible to play IMPAVIDVM using a controller.

4) SUB SURFACE SCATTERING
Rendering has been improved introducing sub surface scattering. Our characters gained a free skin treatment.

5) NEW MECHANIC: FAST SWIMMING
It is now possible to swim fast for a small time before to get tired. This new mechanic is required in the new level, but available everywhere.

6) NEW MECHANIC: MONKEY WALK
Continuing the work to make our hero a true sportsman (or woman)! Now they can execute monkey walk (which by the way is required in the new level).

7) WIND SOUND IMPROVED
Fixed a few glitches in wind sound.

8) SSAO IMPROVED
Removed an unpleasant visual artifact caused by SSAO in 4K. Also capped ssao buffer resolution to 2K because working with a bigger frame buffer is only more expensive and does not improve AO.

9) ROPES IMPROVEMENT
Added a way to stabilize ropes attached to a constrain and reset the forces applied, so they behave always in the same way after realoading a checkpoint.

10) BUG: GHOST PLATFORMS BUG FIXED
Fixed a bug causing some moving platforms to disappear.

11) BUG: RESOLUTION CHANGE BUG FIXED
It is possible now to change resolution without destroying everything and crashing the game!

12) BUG: STUCK PLAYER BUG FIXED
Fixed a bug causing the player to stop responding to inputs after failing a grab.

13) BUG: ROLL ANIMATION BUG FIXED
It is no longer possible to roll right after reloading a checkpoint preventing the player to fall out of bounds in certain conditions.

14) BUG: SHADOWS ARTIFACTS FIXED
Sun light frustum calculation has been improved and shadows at the edges of the field of view are now much better.

15) BUG: DUST RENDERING ARTIFACTS FIXED
Dust does no longer receive shadows.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE COMING SOON
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 
Due to pandemic we are not able to get our actress at the studio and record some audio tracks so we are unable to finish the second cutscene.
However we are working hard for the next update that will introduce ton of improvements, a brand new level, support for controller and MUCH more!

The level is actually ready, but we can not release it yet, because the second cutscene must happen before.

So we are thinking about two possible options:

[olist]
[*] Release the update with all improvements and fixes but NOT the new level and cutscene.
[*] Wait a bit more and then release everything together. If the second cutscene will not take too long, we will opt for this.
[/olist]

Anyway here follows a list of all improvements that will be added in the next release:

2) ROPES IMPROVEMENT
Added a way to stabilize ropes attached to a constrain and reset the forces applied, so they behave always in the same way after reloading a checkpoint.

3) CHANGE RESOLUTION BUG FIXED
It is possible now to change resolution without destroying everything and crashing the game!

4) STUCK PLAYER BUG FIXED
Fixed a bug causing the player to stop responding to inputs after failing a grab.

5) ROLL ANIMATION BUG FIXED
It is no longer possible to roll right after reloading a checkpoint preventing the player to fall out of bounds in certain conditions.

6) SHADOWS ARTIFACTS FIXED
Sun light frustum calculation has been improved and shadows at the edges of the field of view are now much better.

7) DUST RENDERING ARTIFACTS FIXED
Dust does no longer receive shadows.

8) WIND SOUND IMPROVED
Fixed a few glitches in wind sound.

9) SSAO IMPROVED
Removed an unpleasant visual artifact caused by SSAO in 4K. Also capped ssao buffer resolution to 2K because working with a bigger frame buffer is only more expensive and does not improve AO.

10) ADDED CONTROLLER SUPPORT.
It is now possible to play IMPAVIDVM using a controller.

11) FINISHED NEW LEVEL 'FORTITVDO' (NOT RELEASED YET).
The level is ready but we can not release it until the second cutscene is ready. We are working on it right now.

12) NEW MECHANICS: FAST SWIMMING.
It is now possible to swim fast for a small time before to get tired. This new mechanic is required in the new level, but available everywhere.

13) NEW MECHANICS: MONKEY WALK.
Continuing the work to make our hero a true sportsman (or woman)! Now it can execute monkey walk (which by the way is required in the new level).

14) SUB SURFACE SCATTERING.
Rendering has been improved introducing sub surface scattering. Our characters gained a free skin treatment.

notes.title: IMPAVIDVM UPDATE: 29/01/2021
notes.content:
1) ADDED NEW LEVEL 'CELERITAS'.
A brand new level is ready and has been released.

2) BAKES IRRADIANCE AND SPECULAR MAPS.
Since we are using a static sun, we decided to pre-calculate irradiance and specular maps at a much higher resolutions and save them on a separate file. 
We have now much better lighting and performances have increased because we do not longer need to calculate the maps on the fly when entering a new section in the level.
The loading time for all maps is negligible and the only real drawback is we now need to store an average of approx 40 MB of extra data for each level.

3) INCREASED STABILITY.
Fixed a random crash when too much particles are created at the same time and data are streamed to the GPU when the buffer is still growing on a separated thread

4) VISUAL GLITCH RESOLVED.
We had an annoying popup of certain objects (especially floors) that may suddenly appear at particulars camera angles. The issue is now fixed.

5) ADDED A VIDEO TUTORIALS MENU.
Players can use this menu to read a short description of all game-play mechanics and see a short clip showing how to execute the movement in world.


GOALS FOR NEXT UPDATE

- First cut-scene
- Support for controllers
- New level 'FORTITUDO' (maybe)
- Compressed textures (this may take a while, we will release the feature only if finished)

notes.title: First major update for IMPAVIDVM
notes.content:
- Performances improvement: Update running on a separated thread with a fixed frame rate (60 FPS).
This took a lot of time as it was a very complex change, but now physics and update calculation run on a separated thread, incresing the perfomance for several reasons:
1) Better CPU usage because we now split the workload on different cores.
2) The draw loop is only in charge to render the elements in the scene, resulting on a much faster cycle.
3) Because the update happens on a fixed frame rate, the physics simulation of certain objects (like ropes) is greatly improved.
4) The fixed update rate makes the system much more deterministic and less prone to rounding errors.

- Improved tutorial.
The tutorial has been improved in several sections based on the feedback from our testers and is now much clearer.

- Fixed several bugs.
A lot of bugs have been squashed and are no longer a problem.

- Started working on new level CELERITAS
The level is 50% complete and will be available on the next update.

- Started working on first cutscene
We are working on the plot and developing the cut-scenes. The first part will be added in the next update.

The update will be available later this week.
